question: What is the measurement of an ostrich egg?
solution:
The correct answer is __**170 mm × 130 mm**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The measurement of an ostrich egg is **170 mm × 130 mm**.
 
• Ostrich eggs are the largest of all eggs, though they are the smallest eggs relative to the size of the adult bird.
 
• They have a thick shell that is about 2 mm thick, making them quite robust compared to other bird eggs.
 
• Despite their size, the incubation period for ostrich eggs is approximately 42 days.
 
• These eggs are often used in various culinary dishes and can be equivalent to about 24 chicken eggs in volume.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The ostrich is the largest living bird species, and it is native to Africa.
 
• Ostriches can run at speeds up to 70 km/h (43 mph), making them the fastest birds on land.
 
• They have long legs and a large, powerful body, which helps them cover great distances in search of food.
 
• Ostriches are omnivores, feeding on a variety of plant matter, seeds, and insects.
 
• Their eggs are often used in art and decoration due to their large size and sturdy shell.
